description: Generates and validates project documentation: READMEs, ADRs, changelogs, ARCHITECTURE.md, and code documentation. Use when creating, updating, or reviewing any non-code markdown artifact, README file, architecture decision record, ARCHITECTURE document, CHANGELOG entry, or code documentation (docstrings, XML docs, TSDoc). Activates for: (1) scaffolding README, CHANGELOG, ADR, CONTRIBUTING, ARCHITECTURE, or SECURITY files; (2) writing or reviewing doc comments on exported APIs; (3) auditing documentation coverage or staleness; (4) generating release notes from commit history.
